title: Sunny Brook Stables
specs: Horse-first approach focusing on understanding horses before riding
No riding experience needed; suitable for new, beginner, returning, and experienced riders
includes: Meet the horse and learn about their personality, behavior, and body language
Hands-on horsemanship including groundwork and handling
Age- and experience-appropriate introduction to riding
Care after the ride including cooling down and untacking
blurb: Guests meet horses, learn horse behavior, grooming, safety, and horsemanship, and enjoy an age-appropriate introduction to riding. The experience includes groundwork, handling, and care after riding. The stables focus on understanding horses before riding.
extraNote: $95 experience fee is applied toward first month of Academy tuition if enrolled · No obligation to enroll in Academy after experience
